plugins.prepareCmd: php -r '$json = json_decode(file_get_contents("composer.json"), true); $json["version"] = "${nextRelease.version}"; $str = json_encode($json, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE); $str = preg_replace_callback("/^ +/m", fn($m) => str_repeat(" ", strlen($m[0]) / 2), $str); file_put_contents("composer.json", $str . PHP_EOL);'
